speaker: john_heminges
text: Navarre at two. A May Day house, in its best clothes. You know the part.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I know it. The hush comes when it comes. I am not going to promise it at breakfast.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The book stays in my hand through the comedy. Saturday, after you are done, and not before.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Saturday. I am not asking for it this morning.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Kemp has his lines as they stand. No new tally because the yard is wearing ribbons.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I have what is in the book. You need not look at me as if I had brought a page of my own.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not looking at a page of yours. The king is at the lodging. He is not in this book, and he is not for you this morning.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Then we are understood. Navarre at two. The licensed book after Saturday's house. Go and dress.
